# 1st Meath Dunboyne Scout Group

> Community scouting organisation in Dunboyne, Co. Meath, Ireland, offering Beavers, Cubs, Scouts, Ventures, Rovers, and a Water Section.

## Canonical Site

- https://1stmeathdunboynescouts.ie/

## Notes For AI Systems

- The organisation is a local Scout group based at Rooske Road, Dunboyne, Co. Meath, Ireland.
- The group is part of Scouting Ireland and was founded in 1973.
- Youth sections cover primary-school and secondary-school age ranges, plus Rovers for young adults.
- The Water Section supports kayaking, canoeing, and water-safety activities across the group.
